summary.text: Lucius Parshall is a Democratic state representative who currently represents Cheshire District 8 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives and is seeking re-election in Cheshire District 16 on November 3, 2026.
A former music teacher, he says in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running for a fourth term.

paragraphs.text: Lucius Parshall was born in Penn Yan, New York.

He earned an associate degree from Finger Lakes Community College in 1982, a bachelor's degree in music from Ithaca College in 1987, and a master's degree in business administration from Binghamton University in 1989.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as a music teacher, in arts administration for WNYC Public Radio and the Cummington Arts Colony, in food service, as a ranch hand, and as a truck driver.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Parshall said he moved to New Hampshire in the mid-1990s, gained teaching credentials from Keene State College, and taught public school music in the Monadnock region for 20 years before retiring in 2020.
He said he and his wife moved from Keene to Marlborough in 2017 and that he became active in the local Democratic committee.
Parshall assumed office in the New Hampshire House on December 7, 2022, according to Ballotpedia, and for the 2023-2024 session was assigned to the Science, Technology and Energy Committee.
Parshall advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, and faces Republican Alexander Nalevanko in the Cheshire 16 general election.
In the survey, he listed money in politics, ethical standards, education, infrastructure, and the affordability of health care among the policy areas he is passionate about.
